newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE TEARS ARTERY IN HAND.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE TEARS ARTERY IN HAND.

text.p: Alex Criville tore an artery in his hand after crashing at speed during practice on Thursday for the Dutch 500cc motorcycle Grand Prix.
"Criville ripped an artery in his hand and was taken to hospital for surgery," a spokeswoman for the organisers said.
The Spaniard, second in the world championship behind Honda team mate Michael Doohan, crashed on a chicane. He slid off the track with his arm trapped underneath the bike.
Criville was treated at the side of the track for 10 minutes and was then taken away on a stretcher.
Doohan was fastest in practice with Criville in fourth place on the provisional grid.
